privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
LuvUrCity ("we," "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect on this website and how we use it.

## What we collect

- **Contact and consultation forms:** your name, email, phone number, topic, and message.
- **Email signup:** your first name and email address.
- **Review form:** your name, city (optional), rating, and review.
- **Booking:** if you schedule through our calendar, the booking is handled by Calendly under its own privacy policy.
- **Purchases:** consulting payments are processed by Stripe. We never see or store your full card number.

We ask you **not** to include health or medical details in website forms or the City chat helper.

## The City chat helper

City is a scripted helper. It does not send your typed questions to us or to any outside service, and it does not save your conversation. It stores one small note in your browser so it doesn't pop open again during the same visit.

## How we use your information

- To respond to your request and follow up about it.
- To send emails you signed up for. You can unsubscribe anytime.
- To publish reviews you gave us permission to publish.

## Calls and texts

If you give us your phone number, we may contact you by phone or text about your request. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.

## What we don't do

We do not sell your personal information.

## Service providers

This site is hosted by Netlify. Forms are processed through Netlify Forms. Fonts load from Google Fonts. Scheduling uses Calendly and payments use Stripe. Each provider handles data under its own policy.

## Children

This site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

## Your choices

To ask what information we have about you, correct it, or delete it, email luvurcity1125@gmail.com.

## Changes

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body:
By using this website, you agree to these terms.

## Information only

Content on this site is for general educational purposes. It is not legal, tax, medical, or financial advice and is not a guarantee of coverage. Insurance coverage is governed by the terms of each policy. Plan availability, benefits, and pricing vary by state, carrier, and individual situation.

## Insurance services

Insurance is offered by Chasity D. Chapel, a licensed insurance agent, only in states where she is licensed. No coverage is in effect until an application is approved by the insurance company.

## Consulting purchases

Small-business consulting packages purchased on the Shop page are services provided by LuvUrCity. Payment is processed by Stripe. [Refund and cancellation policy to be added by the business owner.]

## Reviews

Reviews reflect individual experiences and may not represent typical results. We publish reviews only with the reviewer's permission and do not edit their meaning.

## Links

Links to outside websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content.

## Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent allowed by law, LuvUrCity is not liable for damages arising from use of this website.

## Contact

Questions about these terms: luvurcity1125@gmail.com.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.body:
LuvUrCity wants everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use assistive technology.

## Our goal

We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, Level AA.

## What we've done

- Text alternatives for images and written descriptions of flyers.
- Keyboard access for menus, the chat helper, and forms, with visible focus outlines.
- Pause buttons for all moving content, and motion turned off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
- Color contrast checked for readability.
- Clear labels on every form field.

## Need help?

If any part of this site is hard to use, contact us and we'll get you the information another way:

- Call or text: 872-777-7991
- Email: luvurcity1125@gmail.com

Please tell us the page and the problem. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

## Ongoing work

We review the site as content changes and fix issues as we find them.
